sloka: हर्षं च शक्रो भगवान् सह सर्वैः सुरर्षभैः।जगाम निहते तस्मिन् राक्षसे पापकर्मणि ।। ६.९१.८७ ।।
transliteration: harṣaṁ ca śakro bhagavān saha sarvaiḥ surarṣabhaiḥ।jagāma nihate tasmin rākṣase pāpakarmaṇi ।। 6.91.87 ।।

translations.english: Glorious Rakshasa of sinful deeds having been killed, all including great sages and Indra felt rejoiced.
